environment.description: Same Go microservice deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 with a custom AppArmor profile (graphql-svc) loaded and enforced. The profile was generated via aa-genprof during integration testing and then manually tightened. The profile specifies: allow read on /srv/uploads/** and /proc/self/**, deny read/write on /** (catch-all), with capability restrictions (no cap_dac_override, no cap_dac_read_search). The container runs with --security-opt apparmor=graphql-svc. Note: the profile uses 'file,' rule with explicit path enumeration — the deny /** rule is a final fallback after the allow rules, following AppArmor's longest-match-wins semantics. The profile also includes a network rule limiting to 'network inet tcp' only. Environment variables are still readable since /proc/self/environ is covered by the /proc/self/** allow rule.
